title: ALOKEME Israel
text: I’m Israël Alokeme, an early-career researcher in emerging infectious diseases and medical entomology. My research interests focus on mosquito–microbiota–pathogen interactions, vector-borne diseases, and the development of data-driven approaches for disease surveillance and control. With research experience across Africa, Europe, and South America, I combine field entomology, molecular biology, microbiome research, bioinformatics, and data analysis. I’m particularly interested in translating scientific knowledge into practical solutions for public health, especially in resource-limited settings.
